# Marouan Boufernana — Portfolio

> Portfolio of Marouan Boufernana: Software Engineer, Game Developer, and 3D Artist. Showcases production fullstack web platforms, indie Unity games, 3D modeling and animation reels, work experience, and technical devlogs.

## Main Pages
- [Home](https://marouan.boufer.com/): Overview and interactive introduction to Marouan Boufernana.
- [Experience](https://marouan.boufer.com/experience): Professional timeline including Tech Lead & Architect at Valinnov, fullstack engineering, and cloud microservices architecture.
- [Software Engineering](https://marouan.boufer.com/software): Production web and fullstack software projects.
- [Game Development](https://marouan.boufer.com/gamedev): Commercial and game-jam indie games built with Unity.
- [3D Modeling & Animation](https://marouan.boufer.com/3d-art): Blender hard-surface modeling, physics rigs, and mechanical animation reels.
- [Blog](https://marouan.boufer.com/blog): Articles on game design, systems architecture, and devlogs.
- [Connect](https://marouan.boufer.com/connect): Contact information and social profiles.

## Featured Projects & External Links
- [Moraja3ati](https://moraja3ati.ma/): Production EdTech & AI tutoring web platform for Moroccan students (React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Docker).
- [Walls & Tower Party](https://marouan.boufer.com/gamedev): Online multiplayer indie game published on Steam and Google Play.
- [Scrap Vanguard](https://marouan.boufer.com/gamedev): Action survival game built in Unity.
- [Itch.io Games](https://marouan-boufer.itch.io/): Playable game jam entries including Under Under, Cursed Demons, and Agent Diplegia.

## Blog & Writing
- [Design Influences & Games I Like](https://marouan.boufer.com/blog/games-i-like): Deconstructing world architecture, kinetic physics, reactive AI, and player agency.
- [Building Modular Combat & Devlog Notes](https://marouan.boufer.com/blog/building-scrap-vanguard-systems): Architecting wave-based survival rigs, Shader Graph effects, and rapid iteration workflows.
